# weapp.dev

> weapp.dev is the official open-source mini-app tooling stack. It brings together styling and build infrastructure for Chinese mini-app platforms and cross-platform projects.

## Official project pages

- [weapp-tailwindcss](https://weapp.dev/projects/weapp-tailwindcss/): Tailwind CSS workflows for mini-apps and cross-platform frameworks.
- [weapp-vite](https://weapp.dev/projects/weapp-vite/): Vite-powered development and builds for multiple mini-app targets.
- [English project index](https://weapp.dev/en/): English overview of the stack.
